title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain California State University-Chico
description: Ten under-21-safe Chico food stops with directly documented service at 10 p.m. or later, spanning campus dining, downtown counters, drive-throughs, and an all-night diner.

cards.title: Dinner at Éstom Jámani
cards.subtitle: On-campus dining until 10 p.m. on selected nights
cards.notes: Check the housing dining schedule before walking over; Monday–Thursday and Sunday service currently extends to 10 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A campus dining room with documented 10 p.m. closing times five nights each week.
cards.evidence_claim: Chico State lists Éstom Jámani Anytime Dining until 10 p.m. Monday–Thursday and Sunday during its published schedule.
cards.source_title: Food and Dining – University Housing – Chico State
cards.access_notes: Open until 10 p.m. Monday–Thursday and Sunday; Friday and Saturday close at 9 p.m. Confirm the academic dining schedule before departure.

cards.title: An Evening Stop at Café 1400
cards.subtitle: A student-housing café open to 10 p.m. on weekdays
cards.notes: Use this option before the weekday cutoff, and confirm that your payment method is accepted before heading to The Social Chico.
cards.short_summary: A housing-community café whose published weekday schedule reaches 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: The Social Chico states that Café 1400 operates from 7 a.m. to 10 p.m. Monday–Friday during the academic year.
cards.source_title: FAQs | The Social Chico Student Housing Near Chico State
cards.access_notes: Open until 10 p.m. Monday–Friday during the academic year; weekend service ends at 2:30 p.m., and the café closes during listed school breaks.

cards.title: Friday or Saturday at Windy's
cards.subtitle: Chinese carryout and dining until midnight
cards.notes: Save this for Friday or Saturday, when the restaurant documents midnight dining, carryout, and delivery service near campus.
cards.short_summary: A Sacramento Avenue Chinese restaurant with weekend service through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Windy's official site lists restaurant, carryout, and delivery hours until midnight on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Friday and Saturday service is listed until midnight; Monday–Thursday and Sunday service ends at 10 p.m.

cards.title: The 11 p.m. Chick-fil-A Window
cards.subtitle: Forest Avenue service six nights a week
cards.notes: Plan this run for Monday–Saturday and check for holiday changes; the Chico operator lists an 11 p.m. closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Forest Avenue fast-food stop with documented service through 11 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Chico Chick-fil-A operator site lists hours of 6:30 a.m.–11 p.m. Monday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Open until 11 p.m. Monday–Saturday and closed Sunday; verify holiday hours directly with the restaurant.

cards.title: The All-Night Esplanade Drive-Through
cards.subtitle: Twenty-four-hour drive-through service
cards.notes: Use the drive-through after the dining room closes; the location page separates its all-day drive-through from 11 p.m. dine-in service.
cards.short_summary: A north-Chico Taco Bell whose drive-through is documented as operating around the clock.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's location page lists the 2398 Esplanade drive-through as open 24 hours every day.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Chico, CA - 2398 Esplanade
cards.access_notes: Drive-through is open 24 hours daily; the published dine-in schedule ends at 11 p.m.

cards.title: The East 20th Street Late Window
cards.subtitle: Drive-through service into the early morning
cards.notes: Choose the drive-through after 11 p.m.; closing ranges from 3 a.m. to nearly continuous service depending on the night.
cards.short_summary: An East 20th Street counter with especially late documented drive-through hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-through closing times of 3 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday, 5:30 a.m. Thursday, and 5:29 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Chico, CA - 1930 East 20th St
cards.access_notes: Drive-through operates until 3 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday, 5:30 a.m. Thursday, and 5:29 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in closes earlier.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 500 Broadway Street
cards.title: Downtown Jack after Midnight
cards.subtitle: Broadway drive-through open as late as 4 a.m.
cards.notes: Walk-in service ends at midnight, so use the drive-through later; verify the posted day because closing times vary.
cards.short_summary: A downtown fast-food counter with documented early-morning drive-through service.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box lists the 500 Broadway drive-through until 3 a.m. most nights, 4 a.m. Friday, and continuous Friday-night-to-Saturday-morning service.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box - 500 Broadway St, Chico
cards.access_notes: Lobby closes at midnight. Drive-through closes at 3 a.m. most nights and 4 a.m. Friday; the official Saturday schedule begins at 4 a.m.

cards.title: A Round-the-Clock Diner Run
cards.subtitle: Twenty-four-hour table service in Chico
cards.notes: Use this when the group needs indoor seating after midnight; the location page documents walk-ins and 24-hour restaurant service.
cards.short_summary: Chico's documented 24-hour diner option for breakfast, lunch, or dinner.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's official Chico location page lists the 675 Manzanita Court restaurant as open 24 hours and welcoming walk-ins.
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists 24-hour restaurant service; contact the restaurant to confirm holiday or exceptional closures.

cards.title: The Business Lane Closing Run
cards.subtitle: Burgers until 1 or 1:30 a.m.
cards.notes: Leave enough travel time for the south-Chico location; Friday and Saturday extend thirty minutes beyond the regular 1 a.m. close.
cards.short_summary: A dine-in and drive-through burger stop with service past midnight every night.
cards.evidence_claim: In-N-Out lists Chico hours until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday, with dine-in and drive-through available.
cards.source_title: In-N-Out Burger - Chico, CA, 2050 Business Lane
cards.access_notes: Open until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday; both dine-in seating and drive-through are listed.

cards.title: The Donut Nook after Midnight
cards.subtitle: East Avenue bakery with overnight hours
cards.notes: Check the split Sunday and Monday schedule before leaving; Tuesday–Saturday currently carries through the night without closing.
cards.short_summary: A named Chico bakery whose current map listing documents overnight access.
cards.evidence_claim: The current Apple Maps place page lists The Donut Nook as open 24 hours Tuesday–Saturday, with overnight split schedules Sunday and Monday.
cards.source_title: The Donut Nook in Chico, CA - Apple Maps
cards.access_notes: Listed open 24 hours Tuesday–Saturday. Sunday and Monday use split schedules that include midnight–1 p.m. and 8:30 p.m.–midnight.

warnings: Hours can change for holidays, academic breaks, or exceptional closures; confirm shortly before departure.
Several destinations are beyond an easy walk from campus and may require a safe ride.
Late-night access at some fast-food locations is drive-through only after the lobby closes.
